scope: Native MIN and MAX over an exact physical stock utf8mb4_bin VARCHAR slot, with global or signed-key grouping and optional DISTINCT.

Aggregation/Aggregate.role: A scoped numeric, count or native text aggregate.
Aggregation/Aggregate.structure: A closed operator, a typed argument or the COUNT(*) role, and an explicit DISTINCT flag.
Aggregation/Aggregate.conditions: MIN and MAX accept a native VARCHAR slot. SUM requires its signed numeric role. The owning grouped input validates every occurrence and physical type.
Aggregation/Aggregate.meaning: Discard NULL operands. Under stock PAD SPACE ordering, choose an actual representative from the least or greatest equivalence class. With no usable operands, return SQL NULL, with the declared result collation.
Aggregation/Aggregate.sql: Emit the native MIN or MAX function over the exact qualified argument, including its written DISTINCT option.

structure: The ordered result fields may combine signed group keys, counts and text extrema over the same filtered physical source.
conditions: A returned extremum must retain its actual stored bytes including trailing spaces. Compare guaranteed legacy grouping order. For later releases, match the observed and expected rows bijectively so duplicate rows remain observable.
meaning: Two strings equivalent under utf8mb4_bin PAD SPACE may both be valid representatives of the same extremum. Compare candidate outputs against the exact set of available representatives for each position and group, including NULL-only groups. No representative outside the extremum class or outside the input is admitted.
sql: Preserve the order of projected fields, exact group key and the filtered source. Let the native aggregate select its permitted representative.
